caption: The drawing depicts a weathervane consisting of several distinct elements arranged on a plain light beige background. At the top is a stylized figure of a horse in mid-stride, harnessed to a two-wheeled cart (sulky), with a human figure seated in the cart holding reins and a whip. Both the horse and the human figure are colored in muted browns and grays, with outlines and shading indicating dimensionality. The cart's large spoked wheels are rendered in similar tones. This upper assembly sits on a horizontal rod. Below this rod is a spherical element, shaded to indicate roundness, attached to a vertical axis. At the base of the vertical axis, four directional indicator arms extend outward, marked with the letters "N", "S", "E", and "W", representing the cardinal compass points. These letters are drawn in brown, utilizing a blocky and angular style. The entire composition is centered on the page with ample negative space around it. The artist's signature and date "Sam W. Funtz Del. 390-1" appears in small writing in the lower right corner.
title: Weather Vane
